$comment: ADR 0040 §2.1: the independently installed nested Cloud package. It is NOT an npm workspace member — it carries its own node_modules so that a Cloud-only driver can never satisfy an Edge import by hoisting. Dependencies are the MEASURED external imports of the cloud/ tree. Five of them (ajv, cors, express, express-rate-limit, yaml) are imported by Agent OS code but were never declared in neomjs/neo's manifest — they resolved transitively there, and independent installation is exactly what stops that working. They are pinned to the versions neomjs/neo actually resolved.
name: neo-agent-brain-cloud
description: The Brain's Cloud plane — Knowledge Base, Memory Core, graph store, and the Dream pipeline. Installed independently of the Host-Edge root.
